baseline.blueprint-unreadable: the blueprint at {path} could not be read: {error}
baseline.contract-restore-failed: failed to restore the contract at {path}: {error}
baseline.contract-unreadable: the contract for node `{node}` at {path} could not be read: {error}
baseline.no-contract: node `{node}` has no contract pointer, so it has no reviewed shape and cannot hold a baseline
baseline.node-not-declared: the blueprint does not declare node `{node}`
baseline.not-recorded: no contract baseline is recorded for node `{node}`
baseline.recorded: recorded the current shape of `{node}` as its contract baseline
baseline.still-live: node `{node}` is declared and its contract loads, so its baseline is live; re-record it rather than dropping it

brief.empty: Nothing to do. The backlog is empty and the project is clean.
brief.gates:
Gates that will judge this unit (all must pass before merge):
  cairn hook all                                       # exit 0
  cairn scan                                           # zero findings

Cairn resolves and runs the project's gates via accept; the brief shows the exact recipe:
brief.gates-skip: language battery ({language})                          # skipped (no gates configured for {language}; configure a `gates:` section in cairn.config.yaml to run build/test checks)
brief.none-ready: No ready work: every open bead is blocked by a dependency. Run `bd ready` and `bd blocked` to see what is gated.
brief.not-found: No bead matches `{id}`. Run `bd ready` to list available work.
brief.not-ready: Warning: this bead is not in the ready set (closed, or blocked by an open dependency). It may already be done or not yet actionable; check `bd ready` before working it.
brief.not-ready-todo: Warning: this todo is not open (in progress, done, or blocked). Check its status in meta/todos/ before working it.
brief.staleness-note-beads: Note: the beads export can lag live Dolt. `bd ready` is authoritative; cross-check before committing to this unit.
brief.staleness-note-todos: Note: native todos live in meta/todos/ and are authoritative for the current checkout; reconcile against the repository's own task tracking before committing to this unit.
brief.todo-not-found: No todo matches `{id}`. Run `cairn status` to list open todos.
brief.unlinked-hint: No graph node is linked to this bead, so no node-specific decisions or contract are surfaced. Bind one with `bd update {id} --label cairn-node:<node>` so future briefs load its constraints.

context.waiting-none: Nothing is waiting for your decision.

decision.created: created meta/decisions/{slug}.md; add the governing node id(s) and fill the sections, then run `cairn scan`
decision.exists: a decision already exists at meta/decisions/{slug}.md
decision.exists-legacy: a legacy decision already exists at meta/decisions/dec.{slug}.md with id dec.{slug}; creating {slug}.md beside it would duplicate the id
decision.invalid-slug: decision slug must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens

feedback.usage: usage: cairn feedback "<what you expected, what happened instead>" [--area <area>] [--severity <level>]

CAIRN_ARTEFACT_FILENAME_DRIFT.body: The artefact at `{path}` is not named after its id.
CAIRN_ARTEFACT_FILENAME_DRIFT.cta: Rename the file to its id without the typed prefix; todos keep `todo.<slug>.md`.
CAIRN_ARTEFACT_FILENAME_DRIFT.heading: Artefact filename drift

CAIRN_CHANGE_TASKS_COMPLETE.cta: Run `cairn change apply {node}` to archive it.
CAIRN_CHANGE_TASKS_COMPLETE.heading: Change tasks complete

CAIRN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY.body: cairn.config.yaml contains an unrecognised top-level key.
CAIRN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY.cta: Use a supported key (`context`, `rules`, `artefact_types`, `targets`, `multi_target`, `ignore`, `gates`, `decision_accumulation_threshold`) or remove the entry.
CAIRN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY.heading: Unknown config key

CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING.cta: Create a contract artefact describing this node's interface.
CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING.heading: Missing contract

CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING_NODE.body: A contract references `{node}`, which does not exist in the blueprint.
CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING_NODE.cta: Fix the node reference in the contract, or declare the missing node.
CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING_NODE.heading: Contract references unknown node

CAIRN_CONTRACT_NODE_SHAPE_DRIFT.body: The baseline for `{node}` was recorded against a different node shape; `{target}` changed.
CAIRN_CONTRACT_NODE_SHAPE_DRIFT.cta: Re-read the contract against the current declaration, then re-record its baseline.
CAIRN_CONTRACT_NODE_SHAPE_DRIFT.heading: Contract not reviewed against current node shape

CAIRN_DECISION_ACCUMULATION.cta: Author one consolidating decision listing the stale set in its `supersedes` field (the parser never reads `superseded_by`), and set each of those targets to `status: superseded`. Both halves are required: a target left accepted keeps counting here and also raises CAIRN_DECISION_SUPERSEDES_STATUS. Superseded decisions keep their provenance and drop out of default payloads.
CAIRN_DECISION_ACCUMULATION.heading: Accepted decisions accumulating

CAIRN_DECISION_AFFECTS_INVALID.cta: Use a normalised repository-relative path without backslashes, absolute paths, or `.` and `..` segments.
CAIRN_DECISION_AFFECTS_INVALID.heading: Invalid affected path

CAIRN_DECISION_CONVERGENCE_UNMET.body: Accepted local decision `{decision}` has receipts that fail the required convergence leg: {leg}.
CAIRN_DECISION_CONVERGENCE_UNMET.cta: Provide two independent, clean, receipt-grade reviews bound to the current subject manifest.
CAIRN_DECISION_CONVERGENCE_UNMET.heading: Decision receipts do not converge

CAIRN_DECISION_MACHINE_BINDING.cta: Use the machine marker only for a converged local decision, or remove it for a maintainer signature.
CAIRN_DECISION_MACHINE_BINDING.heading: Machine-signed binding decision

CAIRN_DECISION_ORPHANED.body: Decision `{node}` references nodes that no longer exist.
CAIRN_DECISION_ORPHANED.cta: Update the decision's node references, or archive if no longer relevant.
CAIRN_DECISION_ORPHANED.heading: Orphaned decision

CAIRN_DECISION_RATIFICATION_INVALID.body: Decision `{path}` declares `{value}` for `ratification:`, but only `local` and `binding` are valid.
CAIRN_DECISION_RATIFICATION_INVALID.cta: Set `ratification:` to `local` or `binding`, or omit it for the binding default.
CAIRN_DECISION_RATIFICATION_INVALID.heading: Invalid ratification tier

CAIRN_DECISION_RATIFIED_BY_INVALID.body: Decision `{path}` declares `{value}` for `ratified_by:`, but only `machine` is valid.
CAIRN_DECISION_RATIFIED_BY_INVALID.cta: Use `ratified_by: machine` only when the loop signs the decision, or remove the field for a maintainer signature.
CAIRN_DECISION_RATIFIED_BY_INVALID.heading: Invalid ratification signer

CAIRN_DECISION_RECEIPT_UNKNOWN.body: Decision `{decision}` names receipt `{receipt}`, but no loaded review has that file stem.
CAIRN_DECISION_RECEIPT_UNKNOWN.cta: Add the review artefact or correct the `receipts:` entry.
CAIRN_DECISION_RECEIPT_UNKNOWN.heading: Unknown decision receipt

CAIRN_DECISION_REFINED_AUTHORITY.body: Decision `{node}` is refined by accepted decision `{target}`. Check the refinement before treating the original as the only authority.
CAIRN_DECISION_REFINED_AUTHORITY.cta: Read the accepted refinement and cite the current decision chain.
CAIRN_DECISION_REFINED_AUTHORITY.heading: Accepted decision has an accepted refinement

CAIRN_DECISION_TIER_BINDING_PATH.body: Local decision `{decision}` lists binding-surface path `{path}` in `affects:`.
CAIRN_DECISION_TIER_BINDING_PATH.cta: Declare the decision binding for changes to this path.
CAIRN_DECISION_TIER_BINDING_PATH.heading: Local decision affects a binding surface

CAIRN_DECISION_TIER_SPAN.body: Local decision `{decision}` names nodes in more than one container.
CAIRN_DECISION_TIER_SPAN.cta: Keep a local decision within one container, or declare it binding.
CAIRN_DECISION_TIER_SPAN.heading: Local decision spans containers

CAIRN_DECISION_TIER_SUPERSEDES.cta: Remove `supersedes:` or declare the decision binding.
CAIRN_DECISION_TIER_SUPERSEDES.heading: Local decision supersedes

CAIRN_HOOK_AFFECTS_SUBSET.body: The commit accepts local decision `{decision}` but changes `{path}`, which is absent from `affects:`.
CAIRN_HOOK_AFFECTS_SUBSET.cta: Add the path before review and refresh the receipt manifest, or remove the acceptance.
CAIRN_HOOK_AFFECTS_SUBSET.heading: Changed path outside decision affects

CAIRN_HOOK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.body: Local decision `{decision}` has receipts for a different subject manifest.
CAIRN_HOOK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.cta: Restore the reviewed files or obtain fresh converged receipts for the current manifest.
CAIRN_HOOK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.heading: Decision receipt manifest changed

CAIRN_INTEGRITY_DUPLICATE_ID.body: The ID `{node}` appears more than once in the blueprint.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_DUPLICATE_ID.cta: Rename one of the duplicates to make every ID unique.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_DUPLICATE_ID.heading: Duplicate node ID

CAIRN_INTEGRITY_INVALID_EDGE_ENDPOINT.body: An edge references `{target}`, which does not exist in the map.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_INVALID_EDGE_ENDPOINT.cta: Check the edge declaration for typos, or declare the missing node.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_INVALID_EDGE_ENDPOINT.heading: Invalid edge endpoint

CAIRN_INTEGRITY_PATH_TIE.cta: Narrow one node's path pattern so each file has exactly one owner.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_PATH_TIE.heading: Path ownership conflict

CAIRN_INTERFACE_HASH_CHANGED.body: The contract hash for `{node}` no longer matches the last recorded value.
CAIRN_INTERFACE_HASH_CHANGED.cta: Run `cairn scan` to accept the new hash, or revert the contract change.
CAIRN_INTERFACE_HASH_CHANGED.heading: Interface changed

CAIRN_MODULE_OVERSIZED.body: `{path}` in `{node}` exceeds the 500-line module-size guideline with no allow-list marker.
CAIRN_MODULE_OVERSIZED.cta: Split the module, or add a `cairn:allow-large-module reason: ...` marker as its first non-blank line.
CAIRN_MODULE_OVERSIZED.heading: Module too large

CAIRN_ORDER_CYCLE.body: A cycle in ordering constraints (dependency edges, or containment contradicting a dependency edge) was detected involving `{node}`.
CAIRN_ORDER_CYCLE.cta: Break the cycle by removing or reversing one conflicting edge.
CAIRN_ORDER_CYCLE.heading: Ordering cycle

CAIRN_PROVENANCE_NO_DECISION.body: Node `{node}` has no decision in its provenance chain.
CAIRN_PROVENANCE_NO_DECISION.cta: Link a decision artefact explaining why this module exists.
CAIRN_PROVENANCE_NO_DECISION.heading: No decision link

CAIRN_RECONCILE_EMPTY_TARGET.body: The target `{target}` at `{path}` discovered zero files during reconciliation.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_EMPTY_TARGET.cta: Check the path is correct, or remove the target if it is no longer needed.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_EMPTY_TARGET.heading: Empty target

CAIRN_RECONCILE_LANGUAGE_UNKNOWN.body: The target `{target}` at `{path}` has a language that could not be inferred from its contents.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_LANGUAGE_UNKNOWN.cta: Set a `targets:` override in cairn.config.yaml, or add files with a supported extension.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_LANGUAGE_UNKNOWN.heading: Unknown language

CAIRN_RECONCILE_ORPHANED_FILE.body: The file `{path}` exists on disk but no blueprint node claims its path.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_ORPHANED_FILE.cta: Add a `path` entry to an existing node, or declare a new node.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_ORPHANED_FILE.heading: Orphaned file

CAIRN_REVIEW_LENS_PROMPT_HASH_INVALID.cta: Record `sha256:` followed by the 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters of the committed prompt file.
CAIRN_REVIEW_LENS_PROMPT_HASH_INVALID.heading: Invalid lens prompt hash

CAIRN_REVIEW_REVIEWER_INVALID.body: Receipt-grade review `{path}` has a reviewer identifier that is not `<model-id>/<lens-id>`.
CAIRN_REVIEW_REVIEWER_INVALID.cta: Use the provider model id, one slash, and the committed lens prompt file stem.
CAIRN_REVIEW_REVIEWER_INVALID.heading: Invalid receipt reviewer

CAIRN_REVIEW_SUBJECT_HASH_INVALID.cta: Use `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
CAIRN_REVIEW_SUBJECT_HASH_INVALID.heading: Invalid review subject hash

CAIRN_REVIEW_SUBJECT_UNMATCHED.body: Receipt-grade review `{path}` carries a `subject_hash` matching no local-tier decision's recomputed manifest.
CAIRN_REVIEW_SUBJECT_UNMATCHED.cta: Keep it as audit-only evidence of an earlier round, or refresh the review against the current subject.
CAIRN_REVIEW_SUBJECT_UNMATCHED.heading: Stale review receipt

CAIRN_SOURCE_SELF_REFERENCE.body: Source `{node}` cites its own artefact file as its evidence, so it records no provenance.
CAIRN_SOURCE_SELF_REFERENCE.cta: Point `file:` at the real evidence, or set `file: null` when the material was never saved to a file.
CAIRN_SOURCE_SELF_REFERENCE.heading: Self-referential source

CAIRN_SOURCE_SHA256_UNEXPECTED.body: Source `{node}` is `tracked` but declares a sha256 digest.
CAIRN_SOURCE_SHA256_UNEXPECTED.cta: Remove the sha256 field, or use `verification: verified` if the content should be frozen.
CAIRN_SOURCE_SHA256_UNEXPECTED.heading: Tracked source declares a hash

CAIRN_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED.body: Source `{node}` has not been verified against its declared hash.
CAIRN_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED.cta: Run `cairn scan` to verify, or update the source record.
CAIRN_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED.heading: Unverified source

CAIRN_SPEC_RULE_DEFERRED_DECISION_INVALI.body: Spec rule `{rule}` ({spec}) defers to `{decision}`, which is not an accepted decision.
CAIRN_SPEC_RULE_DEFERRED_DECISION_INVALI.cta: Update the Deferred-by cell to name an accepted decision artefact.
CAIRN_SPEC_RULE_DEFERRED_DECISION_INVALI.heading: Invalid spec-rule deferral

CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_BLOCKING.body: Todo `{todo}` defers `{code}` at `{location}`, which is a {severity} finding; only Info findings can be parked.
CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_BLOCKING.cta: Fix the finding instead: an Error or Warning stays selecting whatever any artefact declares about it.
CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_BLOCKING.heading: Defers reference targets a blocking finding

CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_INVALID.body: Todo `{todo}` has a malformed defers entry `{value}`; expected `<FINDING_CODE> <path-or-node>`.
CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_INVALID.cta: Rewrite the entry as a finding code, one space, then the path or node the finding was raised against.
CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_INVALID.heading: Malformed defers reference

CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_UNMATCHED.body: Todo `{todo}` defers `{code}` at `{location}`, but no emitted finding matches that reference.
CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_UNMATCHED.cta: Remove the stale `defers:` entry, or correct its code and path or node to match a standing finding.
CAIRN_TODO_DEFERS_UNMATCHED.heading: Stale defers reference

CAIRN_TODO_RELATION_CYCLE.body: Following these links leads back to where it started, so nothing in the loop can ever start. Break one link.
CAIRN_TODO_RELATION_CYCLE.cta: Remove one `blocked_by` or `parent` entry from the loop.
CAIRN_TODO_RELATION_CYCLE.heading: Todos block each other in a loop

CAIRN_TODO_RELATION_UNKNOWN.body: This todo names a related item that does not exist. Fix the name or remove the link.
CAIRN_TODO_RELATION_UNKNOWN.cta: Correct the `blocked_by`, `parent`, or `related` entry, or remove it.
CAIRN_TODO_RELATION_UNKNOWN.heading: Todo points at something that is not there

CAIRN_TODO_STATUS_CONTRADICTION.body: Either this todo is marked blocked with nothing left blocking it, or it is open while something it depends on is unfinished.
CAIRN_TODO_STATUS_CONTRADICTION.cta: Update the status with `cairn todo set`, or fix the links with `cairn todo link`.
CAIRN_TODO_STATUS_CONTRADICTION.heading: Todo status disagrees with its links

CT001.body: Targets for `{node}` with the same contract role have divergent interfaces.
CT001.cta: Review the contract and reconcile the interface shapes.
CT001.heading: Interface contradiction

CT002.body: An intentional asymmetry was detected in `{node}` for contract role `{target}`.
CT002.cta: Review the rationale to confirm the asymmetry is still correct.
CT002.heading: Intentional asymmetry

severity.error: Error: a blocking issue that must be resolved.
severity.info: Info: an observation with no required action.
severity.warning: Warning: a potential issue worth reviewing.

types.extra-edge: A declared edge has no observed source dependency.
types.ghost-node: A declared node has no source files on disk.
types.interface-contradiction: Multiple contracts for the same role have divergent interfaces.
types.missing-edge: An observed dependency has no declared blueprint edge.
types.orphaned-file: A source file exists but no node owns its path.
types.rationale-tension: An intentional asymmetry was detected; review the rationale.

accept.args: [change-id]  Optional change id to lint and check suggested edges for
accept.description: Run the acceptance gate for a change (retired top-level spelling)

archive.description: Archive a completed change (retired top-level spelling)

backlog.args: [node]  Optional node id; omit to list all linked beads

baseline.args:
record <node>  Record or re-record the node's current shape as its contract baseline
  drop <node>    Remove an inert baseline entry (node undeclared, or contract does not load)

baseline-drop.args: <node>  Node id whose baseline is inert: undeclared, or its contract no longer loads
baseline-drop.description: Drop an inert contract baseline entry

baseline-record.args: <node>  Node id declared in the blueprint, holding a contract that loads
baseline-record.description: Record a node's current shape as its contract baseline

beads.args: [node]  Optional node id; omit to list all linked beads

brief.args:
[target]  Optional unit to brief; omit to brief the next ready unit.
            A target starting with `todo.` resolves the native todo at
            meta/todos/<target>.md; any other target resolves as a bead id.

change.args:
new <change-id>              Scaffold a new change
  list                         List active and archived changes
  show <change-id>             Show details of a change
  accept [change-id]           Run the acceptance gate (--dry-run to preview it)
  apply <change-id>            Apply (archive) a completed change
  archive <change-id>          Archive a completed change

change-accept.args: [change-id]  Optional change id to lint and check suggested edges for
change-accept.description: Run the acceptance gate for a change

changes.description: List active and archived changes (retired top-level spelling)

contract.args: <node>  Node id whose contract to show

decisions.args: [node]  Optional node id; omit to list across the project

docstring.args: <node>  Node id to document (JSON output required)

draft.args:
list                    List pending drafts
  show <id>               Show a draft
  edit <id>               Open a draft in your editor
  discard <id>            Discard a draft
  accept <id>             Accept and apply a draft
  create <node>           Generate a contract summary draft for a node

draft-accept.description: Accept a draft proposal and apply it

draft-create.args: <node>  Node id to summarise into a draft
draft-create.description: Generate a contract summary draft for a node

draft-edit.description: Edit a draft proposal in your editor

feedback.usage: cairn feedback "<what you expected, what happened instead>" [options]

files.args: <node>  Node id whose owned files to list

gap.args: <node>  Node the unresolved question belongs to

get.args: <node|bead>  Node id, or a beads task id in human mode

hook.args:
<kind|lifecycle>  Hook kind to run, or install/status/uninstall
  --head  Compare origin/main to HEAD for CI (only with all)

hook-status.description: Show whether a Cairn git hook is installed

locate.args: <symbol>  Exact name of a public symbol to locate across the project

pack.args:
install    Write the pack and record what cairn owns
  update     Refresh pristine files, backfill missing ones
  status     Report installed versions and per-file state
  uninstall  Retire the files cairn owns and still matches
  resolve    Resolve an entry to its prompt and closure bytes
  campaign   Pin, verify, or release those bytes for a campaign
pack.description: Install, update, inspect, resolve, or remove the agent pack

pack-campaign.args:
start   Pin the resolved entry and its closure
  verify  Halt unless the live pack matches the pinned bytes
  end     Remove the campaign snapshot
pack-campaign.description: Pin resolved pack bytes for a campaign, verify them, or release them

pack-install.description: Install the agent pack and record an ownership manifest

pack-resolve.description: Resolve an entry to its prompt bytes and required asset closure

pack-status.description: Report installed pack versions and per-file state

pack-uninstall.description: Retire pack files cairn owns and that are still pristine

pack-update.description: Refresh pristine pack files and backfill missing ones

pending.args: <id>  Decision id to show in full; omit it to list proposed decisions

rationale.args: <node>  Node id whose rationale chain to show

remediate.args: [finding-code]  Optional finding code to focus the plan

rename.args:
<old-id>  Existing node id
  <new-id>  Replacement node id (JSON output required)

research.args: <node>  Node id whose research to list

show.description: Show details of a change (retired top-level spelling)

sources.args: <node>  Node id whose sources to list

todo.args:
new <slug> --node <id>                              Scaffold a todo
  set <slug> <open|in_progress|done|blocked>          Update todo status
  link <slug> [--blocked-by|--parent|--related]...    Add relationship links
  unlink <slug> [--blocked-by|--parent|--related]...  Remove relationship links

todo-link.args: <slug>  Todo slug whose frontmatter gains the links
todo-link.description: Add relationship links to a todo artefact

todo-set.args:
<slug>    Todo slug
  <status>  One of open, in_progress, done, blocked
todo-set.description: Update the status of a todo artefact

todo-unlink.args: <slug>  Todo slug whose frontmatter loses the links
todo-unlink.description: Remove relationship links from a todo artefact

todos.args: [node]  Optional node id; includes the node's descendants. Omit to list across the project

workspace.args: <status|lint|frontier>  Aggregate query to run across the workspace

workspace-lint.description: Aggregate lint findings across a cairn.workspace

flags.area: --area <area>                  Area of cairn the friction relates to
flags.blocked-by: --blocked-by <todo.slug>       Todo stem this todo is blocked by (repeatable)
flags.dry-run: --dry-run                      Preview the gate steps without running them
flags.harness: --harness <name>               Target harness adapter: claude or omp (default: the installed one, else detected)
flags.head: --head                         Compare the merge base with HEAD instead of the index (hook all, CI)
flags.informed-by: --informed-by <id>             Research id that informs the decision
flags.loop: --loop                         Include loop mode and its required asset closure
flags.mermaid: --mermaid                      Emit structure as a Mermaid diagram
flags.node-flag: --node <id>                    Attach the artefact to a graph node (repeatable)
flags.once: --once                         Run a single scan then exit
flags.output: --output <path>                Write export output to this path (required)
flags.parent: --parent <todo.slug>           Containing todo stem (single; link replaces it)
flags.question: --question <text>              The unresolved question to log
flags.related: --related <id>                 Related todo stem or dec./res./src. id (repeatable)
flags.severity: --severity <level>             How disruptive it was (e.g. low, medium, high)
flags.wire: --wire [path]                  Append cairn orientation to agent instructions

hooks.existing: refusing to replace an existing non-Cairn hook
hooks.git-error: unable to locate the Git hooks directory
hooks.pre-commit-conflict: pre-commit configuration owns Git hooks. Add Cairn to that configuration instead of installing a raw hook.
hooks.usage: usage: cairn hook <structural|interface|tension|architecture-decision|all> [--head only with all] or cairn hook <install|status|uninstall> [--pre-push]

init.already: Cairn is already initialized here (cairn.blueprint exists).
init.brownfield-already-applied: brownfield init was already applied; reconciled the agent bootstrap
init.err-completion-marker: brownfield apply succeeded, but recording completion failed: {detail}
init.next-steps:
Next steps:
  1. Describe your system in cairn.blueprint (a starter was written)
  2. Run `cairn scan` to reconcile the blueprint against your code
  3. Wire cairn into your agent: `cairn init --wire` (appends a reference to

actions.add_decision: Blueprint changes require a recorded decision. Create a change directory with a decision artefact.
actions.consolidate_decisions: One or more nodes carry more accepted decisions than the consolidation threshold. Author one decision listing the stale set in its `supersedes` field (the parser never reads `superseded_by`), and set each of those targets to `status: superseded`. Both halves are required: a target left accepted keeps counting and also raises CAIRN_DECISION_SUPERSEDES_STATUS. Superseded decisions keep their provenance and drop out of default payloads.
actions.fix_blueprint: The blueprint has parse errors or integrity issues that must be fixed manually before other actions can succeed.
actions.fix_contracts: Contract artefacts have issues (missing, wrong node, or unknown node). Review and fix contract assignments.
actions.fix_decisions: Decision artefacts have issues (orphaned, invalid status, or missing nodes). Review and fix decision files.
actions.fix_gitignored_path: One or more declared paths match a .gitignore pattern and will appear as Ghost nodes. Un-ignore the path in .gitignore, or correct the path declaration in the blueprint.
actions.fix_order: An ordering cycle was detected in the blueprint (dependency edges, or containment contradicting a dependency edge). Review and fix the conflicting edges.
actions.fix_research: Research artefacts have issues (missing sources or unknown source). Review and fix research files.
actions.fix_sources: Source artefacts have issues (orphan, unverified, or read failed). Review and fix source files.
actions.fix_todos: Todo artefacts have issues (orphan node or invalid status). Review and fix todo files.
actions.init_from_code: No blueprint structure exists but source files were found. Generate an initial blueprint from the existing code.
actions.none: No remediation actions are required. The project is in good shape.
actions.refine: The blueprint has drifted from the code (ghost or orphaned modules). Generate a delta to reconcile the differences.
actions.rename_artefacts: Artefact filenames do not match their ids. Rename each file to the name the finding reports; todos keep the `todo.` prefix.
actions.split_module: One or more claimed files exceed the 500-line module-size guideline with no allow-list marker. Split the module, or add a `cairn:allow-large-module reason: ...` marker as its first non-blank line.
actions.summarise: Interface hashes have changed. Run the summariser on affected nodes to update contracts.
